title: PB2002: the outlines of 52 tectonic plates and the 5,819 steps of their boundaries, each with its class (spreading ridge, transform, subduction, ...) and the polarity of subduction
provider: P. Bird (2003), as converted to GeoJSON by H. Ahlenius (Nordpil), from the GitHub repository fraxen/tectonicplates
format: PB2002_plates.json: GeoJSON, one (Multi)Polygon per plate (properties Code, PlateName), cut at the antimeridian, longitude and latitude in degrees. PB2002_steps.dat.txt: one line per digitisation step (Bird 2003, Table 2), fixed columns: boundary identifier XX?YY (XX the plate on the left travelling along the step, YY on the right; '/' the right-hand plate subducts under the left, '\' the opposite, '-' no subduction), initial and final points, length, azimuth, Bird's relative velocity, elevation, sea-floor age, and the step class (OSR, OTF, OCB, CRB, CTF, CCB, SUB).
coverage: Global: 52 plates, 229 boundary segments, 5,819 steps of mean length 44.7 km
licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0, for the conversion (fraxen/tectonicplates); please credit Hugo Ahlenius, Nordpil and Peter Bird. The model is the electronic supplement of Bird (2003).
citation: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochem. Geophys. Geosyst. 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252.
